title: Scenario: perfect on paper, no spark
caption: They tick every box and you feel nothing. Here's the kind way through.

beats.head: Do you *keep going?*
beats.sub: Some sparks are shy. One more date is fair.

beats.head: If date three is *still* flat,
beats.sub: a kind no beats a polite maybe.

vis.name: Sam
msgs: You're great. I'm just not feeling a spark.

beats.head: A checklist can't fake *alignment.*
beats.sub: It's the fit you can't write down.

beats.head: Send this to someone dating a *checklist.*
